mentions.name: Jewelry DSL and CAD interpreter
mentions.description: A tiny domain-specific language for describing jewelry pieces, with an interpreter that produces CAD files from those descriptions, enabling manufacture via 3D printing or lost-wax casting.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a tiny DSL to describe the jewelry pieces, and an interpreter to produce CAD files. We then either 3D print them or have them produced by lost-wax.
